audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave you Levels 2 through First item and called Level 1 even, while whys[0] and whys[1] say Trundle owns the first two levels, whys[2] calls Level 3 an even skill fight, whys[4] says Subjugate pulls Level 6 back to even, and whys[6] says two items are yours.
audit.why: packet.levelChart reads Trundle, Trundle, Skill, Urgot, Skill, Urgot, Urgot — identical to this page's own whys[] line for line. The chart was simply never updated to the prose.
audit.corrected: Trundle Levels 1-2, skill at Level 3, Urgot at 4-5, skill at Level 6, Urgot at first item and two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your spike with a 25% execute number, when Subjugate is the ability that defines the stage.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80s at 650 range and steals a percent of your health, armour and magic resist, doubling over 4 seconds — it moves your defensive stats onto him. Riot gives no numeric threshold for Fear Beyond Death.
audit.corrected: Level 6 is even: Subjugate is 120s at rank 1 and 650 range, so bait his commit and then use the execute threshold afterwards.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trundle's Q is called 'Bite' in three places and is credited with healing him; Pillar of Ice's terrain is never stated to block your Disdain.
audit.why: The live name is Chomp — damage, a brief slow, and an Attack Damage sap, with an auto-reset on a 3.5s cooldown at 300 range. No heal appears in its text: the healing is King's Tribute (passive, on nearby unit deaths), amplified by Frozen Domain. Pillar of Ice (21/19.5/18/16.5/15s, 1000 range) is impassable terrain, which can strand a Disdain charge.
audit.corrected: Chomp is a 3.5s auto reset that saps your AD — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast, and it does not heal him. Pillar of Ice is real terrain and will wall off Disdain.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death online — at 25% HP Trundle is simply dead. Trade him to half, then the chain threat decides everything.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death online, but so is Subjugate — 120s at rank 1, and it takes your resists. Bait his commit first.

edits.before: - Trundle Subjugate: matchup-defining — Steals your stats. Don’t fight into it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Subjugate: 120s at rank 1, 650 range — it moves your armour onto him. - Pillar of Ice: 21s, and it walls off Disdain.

edits.before: Steals your stats. Don’t fight into it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Subjugate is 120s at rank 1 and reaches only 650 units — stay outside.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain — it can strand Disdain mid-charge.

edits.before: Late game your R is a pick machine: any frontliner dropped under 25% dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Trundle carry threat: 7/10 — end the game before he cashes it.
edits.after: Late game your R is a pick machine: anyone dropped under its threshold dies through everything. Anchor fights around the execute threat and W-shred whoever dives your carries. Trundle carry threat: 7/10 — end before he cashes it.

edits.before: Trundle owns levels 1-2: his Q Chomp does heavy damage plus a slow and heals him, and with only one or two abilities you can't answer that in an even auto war. Give ground, last-hit safely, and don't walk into Pillar range for a free Bite trade.
edits.after: Trundle owns levels 1-2: Chomp is a 3.5s auto reset that saps your AD and slows — it does not heal him, King's Tribute does that off dying minions. With one or two abilities you cannot answer it, so give ground, last-hit safely, and stay outside his 300 range.

edits.before: Bami's Cinder or Frostfire into Bramble stacks your P Echoing Flames and cuts his Bite healing, letting you win extended trades even through his passive regen.
edits.after: Bramble Vest cuts King's Tribute and the bonus healing Frozen Domain grants him — fight outside his W zone and his sustain cannot keep pace with Echoing Flames.

edits.before: Grievous Wounds early to blunt Bite sustain
edits.after: Grievous Wounds to blunt King's Tribute regen

edits.before: Land Pillar to lock you for a Bite-and-run trade
edits.after: Land Pillar of Ice to wall off your Disdain

notes: 'Bite' is Trundle's retired Q name and appeared three times; the live ability is Chomp, and Riot's text gives it no heal — the sustain is King's Tribute (passive) amplified by Frozen Domain (W). The mirror flagged that this page's late-game reasoning elsewhere in the champion leans on an unsupported 'Urgot deals percent-max-HP' claim; none of the fields edited here restate it, and spikes[3]/late are phrased as resist shred, which Black Cleaver does support.
